newsitem.title: USA: Chase unit funds steel waste recycling plant.
newsitem.headline: Chase unit funds steel waste recycling plant.

text.p: Chase Securities Inc said Monday it has completed financing to build the first facility that completely recycles by-products of steel production, including electric arc furnace dust, millscale and sludges, without generating additional waste.

Chase Securities Inc, through its global power and environmental group, said it arranged the debt and equity financing for the project. Technology for the metals recovery process was developed by AllMet Technologies Inc in which Chase Securities was also adviser, it said.

The recycling facility was developed for the Nucor-Yamato Steel Co steel plant in Bylthevile, Ark., Chase Securities said. The amount of the financing extended by Chase Securities, a unit of Chase Manhattan Corp, was not disclosed.
The Chase unit Tomen Corp of Tokyo participated in the debt and equity financing for the facility.
The Nucor-Yamato facility will be completed later this year and an affiliate of AllMet will operate it, it said.
AllMet's recycling plant will process the entire 80,000 ton-a-year output of furnace dust, millscale and sluges at the Nucor-Yamato mill, it said.
